faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: How far in advance should I book?
As early as possible, especially for summer weekends and the WEF period. For smaller events a few weeks is often enough: get in touch and we'll check availability.
Are set-up and a technician included?
Yes. We handle transport, set-up, testing and dismantling, and one of our technicians runs the event on site.
Can I show my own photos and videos on the screens?
Of course. Send us photos, videos or logos before the event: we prepare the content and run it during the evening, including live camera feeds.
Do you work outdoors and throughout Switzerland?
Yes, with outdoor-rated equipment. We review the venue, power supply and weather cover together.
Are cold sparks and fog safe indoors?
Yes: cold spark machines produce no flame and we use professional equipment only. We always check venue rules and smoke detectors in advance.
